results.content: Selective labels occur when label observations are subject to a decision-making process; e.g., diagnoses that depend on the administration of laboratory tests. Inspired by causal models of selective labels, we propose Disparate Censorship Expectation-Maximization (DCEM), an algorithm for learning in the presence of disparate censorship. ##### **Mean-field Analysis on Two-layer Neural Networks from a Kernel Perspective**. In this paper, we study the feature learning ability of two-layer neural networks in the mean-field regime through the lens of kernel methods. In this limit, the learning problem is reduced to the minimization problem over the intrinsic kernel. We also demonstrate that two-layer neural networks can learn a union of multiple reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces more efficiently than any kernel methods, and neural networks aquire data-dependent kernel which aligns with the target function. Our study, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first formal work on weight precision, yields three main results.
